statements.body: I arrived at the headquarters at 1:45 PM. I stayed in the first-floor main lobby having coffee until 2:30 PM. I never went near the basement or the server vault. Later that evening around 6:00 PM, I met Sarah for dinner across town.
At 2:02 PM, I conducted a physical inspection of the north wing. The corridor was quiet, but the server room security light blinked red.
